name: Phone bar: bigger orb, one badge
author: wizard
description: The phone's bottom bar reads at a glance: a 72 px orb (66 px on small phones) with one thin ring and no orbiting dots, spinning arcs or sparkles, 32 px app icons, and one yellow count sitting on the ring, shown on your main agent's desk only. Desks that don't fit hide whole, Home and + always show, and on iPhone the bar is a little taller so a swipe on it never starts in the system's swipe-up zone.
